Role: LLM Model Developer




Role Description:
Responsible for fine-tuning and optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs) with a focus on instruction tuning and domain adaptation to improve performance and contextual relevance.




Must-Have Skills:

Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to Have:

Not Applicable



Experience Required:

Minimum 5 years



Educational Qualification:

15 years of full-time education



Summary:

As a GenAI Engineer, you will design, develop, and deploy AI solutions leveraging both traditional machine learning and advanced generative AI techniques. The role combines strong ML engineering fundamentals with expertise in LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and orchestration frameworks to build scalable, production-ready AI systems.




Key Responsibilities:

Design and develop applications powered by LLMs, multimodal models, and generative AI architectures
Fine-tune foundation models using techniques such as LoRA and PEFT for domain-specific applications
Build RAG pipelines using vector databases like FAISS, Pinecone, or Weaviate
Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Semantic Kernel into production environments
Develop and deploy machine learning models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn
Collaborate with data engineers to build and maintain scalable data pipelines
Implement MLOps/DevOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and automated retraining
Optimize model inference through quantization, distillation, and efficient hardware utilization
Establish evaluation frameworks for both ML and GenAI models (accuracy, fairness, hallucination control, grounding)
Monitor deployed models to ensure performance, reliability, and continuous improvement
Work closely with cross-functional teams to align AI solutions with business objectives
Communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders



Professional & Technical Skills:

AWS, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases
Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain)
Agentic frameworks and GenAI orchestration tools
DevOps tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and mentor junior team members



Additional Information:

Minimum 5 years of experience in LLMs is required
Location: Across India
15 years of full-time education is mandatory

Equifax is seeking creative, high-energy and driven software engineers with hands-on development skills to work on a variety of meaningful projects. Our software engineering positions provide you the opportunity to join a team of talented engineers working with leading-edge technology. You are ideal for this position if you are a forward-thinking, committed, and enthusiastic software engineer who is passionate about technology.


We are looking for a visionary Principal Engineer to act as the single-threaded owner for our Agentic SDLC Strategy. You will not just use AI; you will architect the ecosystem where GitHub Copilot operates as an autonomous agenthandling code generation, incident response, and documentation within a secure, observable Equifax framework.




What You'll Do:

Strategic Roadmap: Define and own the internal product roadmap for GitHub Copilot, treating it as a first-class engineering platform.
Agentic Orchestration: Design and manage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) toolset to enable Copilot to interact with ServiceNow, Atlassian, DataDog, and GCP.
Context Engineering: Translate Equifax engineering standards into version-controlled custom instructions and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) frameworks to shape Copilots persona.
Governance & Security: Establish a "human-in-the-loop" framework for critical actions and enforce code-driven RBAC for GitHub Actions and APIs.
Observability: Implement a robust stack to track Copilots KPIs, monitoring the effectiveness of the agentic system and optimizing prompt accuracy.
Leadership: Mentor senior engineers across Pune and Trivandrum, collaborating with SRE and DevSec leads to ensure compliance with EFX secure software guidelines.

Experience: 10+ years of total software engineering experience (7+ years in cloud-native distributed systems).

Cloud & DevOps: Deep experience with GCP or AWS, Kubernetes (GKE), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Helm).
GitHub Mastery: Advanced knowledge of GitHub Actions, GitHub Apps, and REST/GraphQL APIs.
Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.



What Could Set You Apart:

Early adoption and implementation of Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Proven track record of building RAG systems or developer productivity tools at scale.
Experience with event-driven architectures reacting to GitHub webhooks.
Contributions to open-source AI projects or developer tooling.

Profile :

We are hiring a world-class Prompt Engineer, someone with extreme clarity of thought, deep reasoning skills, and hands-on mastery of modern LLM behavior. It is for someone who understands prompting as a science : evaluation, ablation, latency tuning, hallucination control, guardrails and AGI-aligned orchestration.

Requirements :

- Exceptional reasoning, logic structuring and analytical thinking.

- Ability to design deterministic, controlled, and testable prompts for production behaviour.

- Deep understanding of temperature, top-p, top-k, seed, max-tokens, repetition penalty, and their effects on model behaviour.

- Strong mastery of LLM guardrails, prompt-injection defense, role separation, Meta Logic, and system level prompt design.

- Solid understanding of modern LLMs and NLP systems (GPT, Claude, LLaMA, Qwen, Mistral, etc.).

- Knowledge of low-latency model families, quantization (GGUF, INT4/8), and inference trade-offs.

- Clear understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector DBs including when not to use them.

- Ability to run evaluation pipelines (accuracy, F1, hallucination rate, consistency, JSON validity).

- Highly detail-oriented, structured thinker, fast learner.

- Strong communication, able to explain reasoning clearly and concisely.

- Comfortable building measurable experiments instead of intuition-based prompting.

Responsibilities :

- Design high-accuracy prompts for reasoning, extraction, classification, and multi-step workflows.

- Build robust system + user prompt architectures with strict constraints and safety layers.

- Run temperature, seed, sampling, and ordering ablations to achieve deterministic and stable performance.

- Optimize prompts for latency, consistency, cost, and token efficiency.

- Reduce hallucinations using verification loops, guardrails, retrieval control, and role conditioning.

- Architect governing instructions for multi-agent systems and AGI-aligned assistants.

- Build hierarchical prompt layers (system -meta-controller - task-level - tools).

- Select models based on latency, throughput, context window, and domain-specific performance.

- Collaborate with AI engineers on quantization, distillation, caching, and runtime optimizations.

- Maintain versioned prompt libraries with clear documentation, reproducibility, and experiment tracking.

- Work closely with ML, product, and engineering teams to deliver production-grade, scalable prompt flows.

- Write clear technical documents : architecture diagrams, ablation summaries, evaluation reports, and runbooks.
